title: My Hope Is Built on Nothing Less
lyrics: [C]My [F]hope is built on [C]nothing less [F]than [Bb]Jesus' blood and [C]righteousness.
[C]I [F]dare not trust the [C]sweetest frame, [F]but [Bb]wholly lean on [C]Jesus' [F]name.
[F]On Christ [C7]the [F]solid [Bb]rock I stand; all [F]other ground is sinking [C]sand,
All [F]other [Bb]ground [F]is [C]sinking [F]sand.
My [G]hope is built on [D7]nothing less
Than [Am]Jesus' blood and [D7]righteousness.
I dare not trust the [D7]sweetest frame,
But [Am]wholly lean on [D7]Jesus' [G]name.
On [G]Christ the [C]solid Rock I stand;
All other [G]ground is [D7]sinking sand,
All [G]other [Em]ground is [D7]sinking [G]sand.
When Darkness veils his lovely face,
I rest on his unchanging grace.
in every high and stormy gale,
my anchor holds within the veil.
His oath, his covenant, his blood
supports me in the whelming flood.
When all around my soul gives way,
he then is all my hope and stay.
When He shall come with trumpet sound,
O may I then in him be found!
Dressed in his righteousness alone,
faultless to stand before the throne.
